name: Corrosion under insulation (CUI)
principle: Water ingress into insulation creates an invisible electrolyte film against hot or cold steel, producing the most widespread hidden-corrosion mechanism on process plants: pitting and general loss under cladding that looks intact from outside. Management combines risk ranking (temperature band, insulation type, coating age, environment), inspection through insulation with pulsed eddy current where possible and targeted stripping where not, and prevention at the source: high-quality CUI-resistant coatings applied before insulation, sealed cladding, and design that avoids water traps.

process_steps.name: Lines risk-ranked for CUI by temperature band, service and coating history
Screened through insulation with pulsed eddy current; hot spots flagged
Targeted insulation stripping and visual/UT confirmation at flagged points
Prevention: CUI coatings, cladding sealed, water traps designed out
